verdict.rationale: There is a documented self-serve sandbox sign-up form (Organization ID, company/contact details, terms acceptance) that lets merchants/developers begin evaluating Intelligent Commerce and send test transactions, plus a TAP GitHub reference implementation merchants can adopt to publish/verify agent signatures. However, production merchant enablement is not self-serve: fees/terms require contacting Visa directly ("Contact Visa for fees in Production"), and there's no documented one-click setting or standard merchant agreement flow beyond sandbox evaluation. missing for 10: a documented fully self-serve production onboarding flow (not gated behind 'Contact Visa'), a standard published merchant agreement/terms link, and independent/hands-on merchant confirmation that the sandbox-to-production path works smoothly.
